summary: Sysmenu 3: display model - window_mode enum, resolution and refresh lists
author: pm
body:
One window_mode key migrated from fullscreen/borderless booleans; SDL-style curated resolution list with aspect labels capped at the desktop; refresh list; one apply path for menu, start-up and Alt-Enter.

Plan: .claude/design/plans/system-menu-display-overhaul.md (part of HH-0114).

**Done when:** built, reviewed and checked in game.

**Decision, 2026-11-25 (d-038):** real refresh rate, specified in the engine-neutral graphics protocol (renderer/window interfaces) and implemented per backend; sfml_engine implements it. The whole display model goes through the protocol.

**Editor, 2026-11-26: display model implemented (not committed).**

Protocol (`sources/dependencies/shared/render/display_settings.h`, new, header-only): `window_mode::{windowed, borderless_fullscreen, exclusive_fullscreen}`, `aspect_mode::{letterbox, stretch}`, `display_settings {mode, width, height, refresh_rate (0 = unlimited), vsync, aspect, windowed_borderless}`, `display_mode`, `resolution_option` / `refresh_option` with labels ("1920 x 1080 (16:9)", desktop marked " - Desktop"; "Unlimited" / "N Hz"), the SDL curated tables and builders, `nearest_resolution`, persisted keys. `IWindow` gained `apply_display_settings` (stages before realize; after, rebuilds only for mode / exclusive size / decoration, in place for vsync, cap, aspect, windowed size; returns false on fallback), `get_display_settings` (what is in effect), `is_window_mode_supported`, `get_desktop_mode`, `get_resolution_options`, `get_refresh_options`. Removed: `IWindow::set_fullscreen/set_borderless/is_borderless/set_size/set_framerate_limit/get_framerate_limit/set_vsync_enabled/is_vsync_enabled/set_fullscreen_stretch/is_fullscreen_stretch`, `window_params`, `Window::set_size/set_borderless`, `IRenderer::set_fullscreen/change_display_mode/set_fullscreen_stretch`.

sfml_engine: one `create_native_window` path; exclusive picks the closest `getFullscreenModes()` size, then sets the rate with `ChangeDisplaySettingsEx` + `DM_DISPLAYFREQUENCY` (`hb::platform::set_display_refresh_rate`, CDS_FULLSCREEN so SFML's cleanup restores it). Desktop mode cached while exclusive. Linux: exclusive unsupported, folds to borderless; refresh list is the curated list only (no driver rates). Frame cap: vsync on = monitor rate, off = refresh_rate, background throttle unchanged.

Settings migration (settings.json): `windowMode` ("windowed"/"borderless"/"exclusive") from `fullscreen` (true -> borderless: today's fullscreen showed the desktop size, keeps the windowed size); `windowedBorderless` from `borderless` (it was the windowed title-bar style, not fullscreen); `refreshRate` from `fpsLimit`; `aspect` from `fullscreenStretch`; `vsync` kept. Old keys dropped on the first save after migration. The 5-size 4:3 snap is gone; start-up snaps the size to the window's list (capped at the desktop).

Behaviour change: the saved mode is now applied at start-up (before, `fullscreen` was saved but never applied).

Checks: Windows Debug build verified (all three cycles); Linux client and server builds verified (WSL Ubuntu); in game unverified (deploy would also ship another agent's uncommitted staged files).

For HH-0118/0119/0120: snapshot = `get_display_settings()`, apply, revert = apply the snapshot; use the bool to warn on fallback; grey resolution under borderless, aspect under windowed; offer modes via `is_window_mode_supported`. Alt-Enter: toggle `mode` between windowed and the last fullscreen mode through `apply_display_settings`.

**Editor follow-up, 2026-11-26:** 1440x1080 added to the curated 4:3 table (it was one of the old five sizes). Resolution cycling now steps to the first size past the current one, so a size the monitor chose in exclusive still moves on. In exclusive, `get_display_settings()` reports the size and rate actually in effect, and apply returns false when the mode switch did not land. Windows and Linux client builds re-verified. Not run in game. The Display Mode row can enter exclusive with no keep-or-revert until HH-0118.

**Review fix note, 2026-11-26 (finding 5, as designed):** in exclusive fullscreen the refresh rate the monitor actually switched to (the nearest offered) replaces the requested rate in the settings in effect, and so also becomes the frame cap and the saved refreshRate.

**Verified, 2026-11-25:** Windows Debug and Linux client/server builds pass; Opus review PASS after fixes (re-review PASS); deployed client starts and the real settings.json migrated (display.fullscreen/borderless/fpsLimit/fullscreenStretch -> windowMode/windowedBorderless/refreshRate/aspect; the other 29 keys unchanged; backup in .claude/scratch/coordinator/settings_backup/). Exclusive mode and the refresh-rate switch were not exercised in game.
